control_limitations: policy persistence and external entitlement systems remain future work

production quota and distributed enforcement remain future controls

control_limitations: audit integrity, retention and central log shipping are future production controls

control_limitations: controls are not operationally effective until deployed through an approved process
description: Cloud IAM, encrypted storage and Terraform controls are configured as code, but no cloud deployment exists.

control_limitations: container vulnerability results are unavailable when Docker daemon is not running
description: Container hardening includes non-root runtime and pinned Trivy scan wiring, but local image scans depend on Docker availability.

control_limitations: controls are not a substitute for production platform controls or release gates
description: Implemented Milestone 1, 2 and 3 controls reduce but do not eliminate local API and governance risks.

control_limitations: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy enforcement depends on the selected CNI configuration
